value.LineDescription:

Scope of works
1. Protecting and covering the fwd teak deck with blues sheet.

4. Making the access (additional hatch cover) on the bulkhead in anchor room. 
5. Build up the carne base and laminating according to the attached drawing.
6. Modifying the longitudinal and transverse beams at fwd storage area. 
7. Reinforcing the backing plate including the tapping for crane and crane support. 
8. Installation of the crane support. 
9. New cable layout and installation of the control boxes according to the proposal. (MSB to anchor room) 
10. Install the crane including the cables connection. 
11. Commissioning and load testing. 
12. Final finishing works of paint and teak deck at crane base area after installation of crane

value.LineDescription:
Repairing the several paint scratches on the hull (silver metallic color) and near the fender area. (white color) 
Scope of works:-
1 Preparing the scaffolding at port side and covering the are 
2. Utilize air conditioning to maintain the proper temperature
3. Sanding the area down to the primer with P120 grit paper to remove scratches
4. Prepare the surface and apply primer, undercoat, metallic coat, and clear coat.
5. Sanding after the application of each coat. Water sanding and buffing polishing to complete paint application.
6. Address deeper damages on the bow area by sanding down to the fiber layer using P32 or P40 grit sanding paper.
7. Apply resin, fiber mat, and Aerosil powder to build a new layer.
8. Sanding and prepare the surface, then apply primer and proceed with the metallic paint application
9. For the fender paint work, sanding to remove scratches, apply filler, and sanding again to prepare the surface and white paint application
Note:
1. Paint code and paint manufacturer details need to be provided by customer
2. Yacht must be drydocked at Al Jaddaf dry docks
3. During any stage of paint application, no other sanding works will be allowed on the yacht
4. Job will be completed in 8 to 10 working days, subject to material availability.

value.LineDescription:
Boero paint on the exterior hull in Golden color including scaffolding, AC, ventilation & tenting etc.
Superstructure in black colour 2K - area as per drawing - PAINT 2 and PAINT 3 - TOTAL -217m² Exterior hull area paint with 2K Black color 
As per the drawing exterior surface area details and paint profile Total area as per the drawings - PAINT 1 - HULL -150m², MAIN DECK- 80m², UPPER DECK -190m² 
Complete Hull exterior Boero golden paint total area as per the drawings 420m²
Scope of works:-
1. Preparation of the scaffolding and tent around the hull
2. Dismantle the necessary fitting and covering with protecting the fittings and deck area
3. Arrange the AC and ventilation in the tent
4. Sanding the existing paint/Gelcoat from hull and washing the hull 
5. Application of dry guide with long board sanding 
6. Boero delta 3000 or defender grey primer application, 
7. Boero Epoyacht & epomar body filler filling in required area
8. Boero ultra build primer application on the entire hull. 
9. Two to three coats of Boero Epoply primer and two to three coats of marine grade Boero gold and then clear coat to the exterior of Hull
10. After final paint remove the protection cover
11. Buffing and polishing as per the paint specification 
12. Back to fix the necessary fitting
Note- Paint is Boero - CHALLENGER PRO 675.405 CORDOVAN GOLD
According to the following and standard paint process technique, apply a build-up thickness.
(Wet film thickness: 250 microns; dry film thickness: 3–4 mils; 100 microns) for primer
(Wet film thickness: 100 microns; dry film thickness: 50 microns) for paint .
( Wet film thickness :100μm; dry film thickness :50μm) - for clear coat

value.LineDescription:
Painting -GC
Boero paint on the exterior hull in Golden color including scaffolding, AC, ventilation & tenting etc.
Superstructure in black colour 2K - area as per drawing - PAINT 2 and PAINT 3 - TOTAL -217m² Exterior hull area paint with 2K Black color 
As per the drawing exterior surface area details and paint profile Total area as per the drawings - PAINT 1 - HULL -150m², MAIN DECK- 80m², UPPER DECK -190m² 
Complete Hull exterior Boero golden paint total area as per the drawings 420m²
Scope of works:-
1. Preparation of the scaffolding and tent around the hull
2. Dismantle the necessary fitting and covering with protecting the fittings and deck area
3. Arrange the AC and ventilation in the tent
4. Sanding the existing paint/Gelcoat from hull and washing the hull 
5. Application of dry guide with long board sanding 
6. Boero delta 3000 or defender grey primer application, 
7. Boero Epoyacht & epomar body filler filling in required area
8. Boero ultra build primer application on the entire hull. 
9. Two to three coats of Boero Epoply primer and two to three coats of marine grade Boero gold and then clear coat to the exterior of Hull
10. After final paint remove the protection cover
11. Buffing and polishing as per the paint specification 
12. Back to fix the necessary fitting
Note- Paint is Boero - CHALLENGER PRO 675.405 CORDOVAN GOLD
According to the following and standard paint process technique, apply a build-up thickness.
(Wet film thickness: 250 microns; dry film thickness: 3–4 mils; 100 microns) for primer
(Wet film thickness: 100 microns; dry film thickness: 50 microns) for paint .
( Wet film thickness :100μm; dry film thickness :50μm) - for clear coat

2. Washing and cleaning with acetone at grinding areas.

value.LineDescription:
Temporary repair the Hull bottom damages onboard Ship
Scope of works:
1. Cover and protect the area surrounding the damage.
2. Chip and grind around the damaged area.
3. Apply a resin coating and fill with blue paste.
4. Temporarily laminate the damaged area to prevent seawater infiltration
5. Apply Gelcoat paste to the laminated area 
6. Roughly sand and finishing 
7. Apply the primer and antifouling 
8. Transportation charges to Khorfakkan as well return 
9. Transportation charges for Tools collection from Khorfakkan
10. Food and other necessary expenses 
Note: 
1. The temporary repair is based on visual inspection.
2. The comprehensive repair procedure will be based on the internal and external structural condition and its impact.
3. Cigisped will coordinate to Gulf Craft service team for necessary clearance upon arrival at Khorfakkan Port.
Disclaimer: Estimation is based on initial inspection. Upon start of rectification works, we might have to alter quote depending on the extension of damage

value.LineDescription:
Repair the exterior damages and painting at Several area
Area to be covered:
Exterior superstructure, Sunroof, Superstructure side wall port & stbd side, Sunbed
area, Anchor area, Swimplatform side wall port & stbd side, Exhaust cover port & stbd side, All windows port side &
stbd side (As there have corrosion & bubbles), Non-skid paint area on sunroof, sunbed, steps in bow area & anchor area.
Scope of works Boero metallic paint process for Alloya Sanlorenzo 40m Yacht
1. Full boat cleaning/washing by freshwater. 
2. Protection covering for some accessory by using brown paper & blue protection sheet & plastic roll by using 3M masking tape in required area. 
3. Removal of some exterior required accessory, marking & packing in storage area. 
4. Guide coat application for surface checking & long board block sanding by using P60, P80, P120 & P220 grid sandpaper. 
5. Checking & removal of air bubbles & cracks until aluminum surface. 
6. Cleaning full surface with clean water & degreaser to apply delta 3000 primer for up down surface, bubbles & cracks area. 
7. After curing primer, applied Boero epoyacht filler for up down surface, bubbles and cracks area. 
8. In some area applied boero epomar fine filler for pin hole covering. 
9. After curing filler, applied sanding, cleaning, degreaser & UCHB primer in all treated required area.
10. Complete hull again sanding with P220 grid paper by using long board block. 
11. Entire tent & yacht washing / cleaning by freshwater. After dry full boat surface cleaning by degreaser.
12. Fixing new protection & yacht covering by using brown paper, plastic roll, blue protection sheet & 3M masking tape for primer application
13. Two coats of Boero Epoply primer, sanding, cleaning & degreaser application. 
14. Again, guide coat application for checking pin hole & apply one coat primer if required after cleaning, washing & degreaser application. 
15. Again, sanding by machine using P320 & P400 sandpaper. 
16. Removal all old protection covering & masking tape 
17. Full hull paint surface cleaning / washing by freshwater. 
18. After dry, new protection covering by using, plastic roll, brown paper roll, blue protection sheet, 3M blue masking tape & fine line tape 
19. Application of degreaser' to clean the surface for paint application. 
20. Two coat Boero undercoat for metallic paint. 
21. Sanding & cleaning. 
22. Removal old protection, apply new protection covering & degreaser application for metallic paint application. 
23. Two to Three Coat of marine Boero metallic paint. 
24. Again sanding, old protection removal & cleaning application. 
25. New protection covering & degreaser application to apply 2 to 3 coat Boero 
26. Topcoat clear paint application. 
27. Final application of buffing & polishing by using Farcella 1+2 polish for new paint surface. 
28. Installation back removed accessory on existing place
29. Marine silicon application in required area 
30. In last full yacht washing including cleaning and sight cleaning. 
Paint thickness:
1. For primer wet film thickness: 150–300 microns; dry film thickness: 3–4 mils; 75–150 microns 
2. For metallic paint wet film thickness: 90–130 microns; dry film thickness: 40–60 microns

1. Job completion will be 80 to 90 working days
2. Water, AC (all the time to maintain standard temp), electricity, scaffolding, storage (to store Materials, tools and other accessories), shrink wrap tenting & its maintenance arrangement from Customer side.
3. Meanwhile working by other companies or teams for any paint damage or modification will be informed & charges extra
4. We will be requiring special permission to work 6 days a week, on daily bases 9-10 working hours with standard lunch break ( mid-day break as per the UAE MOL law )
5. If Yacht is going to drydock in DMC all entry pass for team & material to be arranged from customer side
6. The supplementary quotation will follow (for prior approval) in case of extra materials or man hours are required to complete the job.
7. Completion of jobs will be subjected to availability of parts.
8. The works will be executed as per company's general terms and conditions, can be furnished upon request yacht has to be fully insured for any unforeseen event and its customer responsibility.

1. Dismantle the shaft, propeller, coupling, and related components, including submission of the shaft clearance report.

8. Reinstall the shaft, propellers, and coupling after balancing and trueness verification.

Note: Additional charges will apply if any damages to the propellers or shafts are identified during balancing or trueness checks.

value.LineDescription:
Repairing the structural damage at Fwd. area in stbd side including the repainting around the repaired area (Black & white paint) 
Scope of works: 
1. Mobilize and demobilize the technicians to onboard
2. Provide fire watch during hot works
3. Renewal of side shell
4. Carry out preparation of hot works and marking of damaged area 
5. Carry out cropping of damaged side shell area including fabricate the new plates
6.  Carry out fit up and welding.
7. AWL Grip paint application as per following details
7-1. Awl grip paint application for superstructure damaged entire side wing stbd side from cockpit edge to front side glass area & superstructure side wall damaged white paint area. Three local touches up on main hull port side.
7-2. Protection covering and sanding the exterior required area be the first step in the painting process. 
7-3. Dry Guide coat application and long board block sanding. 
7-4. Hull guard extra epoxy primer application on filler filling required area, awl fair lw filler application.
7-5. High build primer application on filler filling surface. 
7-6. Again sanding & degreaser application new protection covering & 2 to 3 time apply 545 epoxy primer, sanding, washing cleaning surface, removal old protection & new protection covering & degreaser application to apply 2 to 3 coat coat awl grip Graphite black & Matterhorn white paint application.
7-7. Two to three coat awl grip HDT clearcoat . In last wet sanding & buffing polishing by using farcella G3 1+2 compound & wax.
8. Scaffolding supply,  erection entire yacht & shrink wrap tenting entire yacht for paint application
9. Supply of Air condition package 2 x 25t 
Materials and Notes-
1. Marine Gr. 5083 H321/116 Aluminium plate 2700 x 800 x 8 mm
2. Marine Gr. 5083 H321/116 Aluminium Plate 2500 x 500 x 8 mm
3. Aluminium Pipe 3” -2500 mm
4. Carry out NDT inspection of side shell weld joints -3 visits
5. Carry Out Vacuum test of accessible weld joints -1 visit
6. Please note that our scope does not include any interior work. If any access needs to be opened or created, additional charges will apply.

8. Inspection of firefighting equipment, including extinguishers, fixed systems, and fire alarms

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of FEQ Burma teakwood 10mm thickness straight Planks. (Total area = 106m²)
Scope of works: 
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection
2. Removing of existing Teakwood and Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris
3. Making template of entire Teak Deck and cutting of Teakwood as per required size with joining of Teak as per templates 
4. Filling of Sikaflex 298 Black deck caulking in the grooves, after drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves
5. Sanding of Teak deck surface to make it smooth & uniform
6. Sanding of deck (substrate) to get appropriate profile for bounding and cleaning of deck
7. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC black, 
8. After drying process, cleaning of extra adhesive from Teakwood grooves and cleaning of groove lines
9. Cleaning the groove by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning 
10. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC, 
11. After curing extra recaulking cutting and sanding by using flat sander with P80 grid paper
12. Sanding the surface to make it smooth & uniform
13. Hand sanding where is not access by machine, in last washing & cleaning
14. Teak plank size 50mm wide 10mm thickness (After sanding and finishing) including groove (Groove width 5mm, depth 10mm)
15. Any material required other than quoted will be charged extra
16. In case of deck levelling required, will be additional charges.
Areas to be covered :- Sun deck, Main deck, Swimplatform and all exterior steps.

Perform Repair and QL1 Service as per the findings on both main engines.
Note: The QL1 service must be performed in accordance with MTU requirements, whether or not QL2 service is approved. If any additional parts or labor are required, they will be quoted separately.
Scope of Work:
1. Drain engine oil and replace defective oil pan gaskets on both main engines.

7. Perform valve clearance adjustments on both main engines.

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of FEQ Burma teakwood 10mm thickness straight Planks. 
Scope of works: 
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection 
2. Removing of existing Teakwood and Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris 

3. Making template of entire Teak Deck and cutting of Teakwood as per required size with joining of Teak as per templates 
4. Filling of Sikaflex 298 Black deck caulking in the grooves, after drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves 
5. Sanding of Teak deck surface to make it smooth & uniform 
6. Sanding of deck (substrate) to get appropriate profile for bounding and cleaning of deck 
7. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC black, 
8. After drying process, cleaning of extra adhesive from Teakwood grooves and cleaning of groove lines 
9. Cleaning the groove by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning 
10. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC, 
11. After curing extra recaulking cutting and sanding by using flat sander with P80 grid paper

8. Cutting the mesh fabric according to the template and stitching.
9. Set up and final installation of awing

value.LineDescription:
Repairing the several paint scratches on the hull (silver metallic color) and near the fender area. (white color) 
Scope of works:-
1 Preparing the scaffolding at port side and covering the are 
2. Utilize air conditioning to maintain the proper temperature
3. Sanding the area down to the primer with P120 grit paper to remove scratches
4. Prepare the surface and apply primer, undercoat, metallic coat, and clear coat.
5. Sanding after the application of each coat. Water sanding and buffing polishing to complete paint application.
6. Address deeper damages on the bow area by sanding down to the fiber layer using P32 or P40 grit sanding paper.
7. Apply resin, fiber mat, and Aerosil powder to build a new layer.
8. Sanding and prepare the surface, then apply primer and proceed with the metallic paint application
9. For the fender paint work, sanding to remove scratches, apply filler, and sanding again to prepare the surface and white paint application
Note:
1. Paint code and paint manufacturer details need to be provided by customer
2. Yacht must be drydocked at Al Jaddaf dry docks
3. During any stage of paint application, no other sanding works will be allowed on the yacht
4. Job will be completed in 8 to 10 working days, subject to material availability.

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of the port and stbd side P-brackets including the laser alignment.
Scope of works: 
1. Open interior panels and cut the lower deck floor to create access to both P-brackets.
2. Disconnect earth cables
3. Remove mounting bolts and take out both existing P-brackets
4. Prepare moulds of both brackets for manufacturing through an authorised local supplier
5. Manufacture two palm-type P-brackets using CU3 NIALBR (Nickel Aluminium Bronze), matching the original shape and dimensions to suit standard cutlass bearings
6. Rebuild the cut-out area, including FRP reinforcement as required and reinstall interior panels
7. Position both new P-brackets and perform laser alignment
8. Securely fix brackets post-alignment, reconnect earth cables, and verify electrical continuity
9. Installation of new cutlass bearings 4 Nos 
10 Installation of existing shafts, propellers, and couplings
11. Perform final shaft alignment

9. Modifying all air handler drains line connections. 
10. Passing the new electrical cables from the MSB to chillers, sea water pump and chilled water pump. 
11. Removing the existing duct and fixing the new duct as per units capacity.

Approx area 119m² (Area to be confirm according to the actual measurement) 
Scope of works: 
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection
2. Removing of existing Teakwood and Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris
3. Making template of entire Teak Deck and cutting of Teakwood as per required size with joining of Teak as per templates 
4. Filling of Sikaflex 298 Black deck caulking in the grooves, after drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves
5. Sanding of Teak deck surface to make it smooth & uniform
6. Sanding of deck (substrate) to get appropriate profile for bounding and cleaning of deck
7. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC black, 
8. After drying process, cleaning of extra adhesive from Teakwood grooves and cleaning of groove lines
9. Cleaning the groove by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning

11. After curing extra recaulking cutting and sanding by using flat sander with P80 grid paper
12. Sanding the surface to make it smooth & uniform
13. Hand sanding where is not access by machine, in last washing & cleaning
14. Teak plank size 65mm wide 12mm thickness (After sanding and finishing) including groove (Groove width 4mm, depth 5mm)
15. Any material required other than quoted will be charged extra
16. In case of deck levelling required, will be additional charges.
Areas to be covered :- Upper deck

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of the Burma teak decking (First European Quality FEQ) at fly bridge, 10mm Thickness Groove size 5mm wide x 5mm deep Approx area 218m²
Scope of works:
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection
2. Removing of existing Teakwood and Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris
3. Making template of entire Teak Deck and cutting of Teakwood as per required size with joining of Teak as per templates
4. Filling of Sikaflex 298 Black deck caulking in the grooves, after drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves
5. Sanding of Teak deck surface to make it smooth & uniform
6. Sanding of deck (substrate) to get appropriate profile for bounding and cleaning of deck
7. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC black,
8. After drying process, cleaning of extra adhesive from Teakwood grooves and cleaning of groove lines
9. Cleaning the groove by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning
10. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC,
11. After curing extra recaulking cutting and sanding by using flat sander with P80 grid paper
12. Sanding the surface to make it smooth & uniform
13. Hand sanding where is not access by machine, in last washing & cleaning
14. Any material required other than quoted will be charged extra
15. In case of deck levelling required, will be additional charges.
16. Areas to be covered :- Swimplatform, main deck and Mid deck area
Note - Plank width, border width & design as per existing deck, Teak grill one pcs included for anchor area In the above scope, removal of the old teak deck is included which involves removing the existing teak plywood, and filler underneath. After deep sanding, if any surface unevenness (up/down) is found and requires additional filler application, the cost for filler filling will be charged separately

value.LineDescription:
Exterior hull and superstructure complete painting (White and navy blue color)
A. Scope of works:
1. Lifting the yacht and safely placing at marina for long time storage 
2. Complete washing the boat including underwater hull
3. Dismantle the necessary fittings and accessories and placing safely in the storage 
4. Arrange the Shore power connection and Sea water lie to chiller system (If required)
5. Preparation of Scaffolding around the boat
6. Preparation of the Shrink-wrap tent
7. 4 x Outdoor AC units for each side (20 t) 
8. Hiring rental generator with 200-250 kva
9. Prepare the 2 x Compressor with dryer, 3 stage filtration
10. Prepare the Power cables, Distribution Panels, Lights etc
11. Prepare the extractor with filtration box
12. Prepare the PPE
14. Sanding the exterior surface with long board
15. Cleaning and washing apply primer and sanding again
16. Cleaning again and apply filler for pinholes and minor damages 
17. Sanding again and apply primer and build thickness 
18. Apply the topcoat with white and blue according to the paint specification with Alexseal Acrylic X Paint System
19. Final cleaning and remove the covering 
20. Re-install the fittings and accessories 
21. Dismantle the scaffolding, AC and ventilation system etc.
22. Buffing and polishing after painting will be done only where required to reach the acceptance criteria. Full polishing is not a part of the scope

B. The following areas are excluding the painting until further discussions
1. Tenders & Jetski
2. Exterior storage lockers & tender garage (Inner area)
3. Exterior storage doors inner area, locker doors inner area, transom door inner area & hatches inner area
4. Liferafts storage inner area repair and paint
5. Life rafts and other deck equipment
6. Full polishing
7. Any additional fairing required for shape improvement is currently out of scope
8. Generator fuel (will be invoiced monthly as per use)

C WARRANTY
1. Paint product warranty is provided by the paint manufacturer as per their terms and conditions
2. Paint application warranty is 1 year from day of launching back in the water.

value.LineDescription:
General servicing of the port and stbd side Engine including the functional testing.
Scope of works:
1. Perform QL1 Service and valve clearance
2. Drain engine oil & coolant.
3. Replace the air filters, fuel filters, fuel W/S & breather insert on both main engines.
4. Remove and refit centrifugal oil filters on both main engines followed by inspection, cleaning & replacement of paper elements
5. Removed and refit of automatic oil filter element followed by inspection , cleaning & replacement of gasket kit on both engines
6. Remove and refit all cylinder’s valve covers followed by replacing gasket with new ones.
7. Top-up engine oil and coolant on both main engines
8. Perform valve clearance adjustments on both main engines.
9. Connect MTU diagnostic tool and Record Engine parameters
10. Perform sea trial and extract log file for both Mes
11. Submit complete technical report
12. Replacement of fuel filter & Air filter 4 Nos each
13. Replacement of paper element, filter element & Gasket kit 2 Nos each
14. Replacement of O Ring 24 Nos
15. Replacement of primary filter element 4 Nos
16. Replacement of Gasket & oil separator 12 Nos each
17. Replacement of coolant RXSOLG93-94 and engine oil 
Note:- 
1. If any additional parts/workmanship are required, it will be quoted additionally.

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of the Burma teak deck FEQ 10mm thickness x 2.3m length x 50mm wide and Groove size 5mm wide x 5mm deep Approx 66m² (Green Shaded area)
Scope of works: 
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection and removing of existing teakwood 
2. Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris then cleaning of all the decks
3. Making template and cutting of Teakwood as per required size 
4. Bounding of Teak decking panels with Sika 298 marine adhesive 
5. Cleaning of groove lines by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning groove
6. Application of Sika Primer 215 and filling of Sika 290 DC Pro Black deck caulking in the grooves 
7. After drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves 
8. Sanding the surface to make it smooth & uniform 
Areas to be covered ( Marked in Blue ): 
1 Sun Deck Shaded sitting area 
2 Stern Steps to Sun Deck 
3 Port side steps to Sun Deck 
4 Main Deck Cockpit area 
5 Main Deck Gunnel area port & stbd side 
6 Main Deck Port and Stbd Gangway entry step (below door) 
Note: 
> Burma Teak plank size will be Max 2.3m length & 50mm wide 
> Groove size: 5mm wide x 5mm deep groove +-10% 
> Any addition or subtraction will be additional charges

4. Once installed, the planks will be sanded, levelled, and finished to match the surrounding area, with protective coverings applied to surfaces during sanding to prevent any damage.

value.LineDescription:
Replacement of FEQ Burma teakwood 10mm thickness straight Planks. 
Scope of works: 
1. Covering of all the working areas with plastic and cardboard for protection
2. Removing of existing Teakwood and Sanding of Deck to remove adhesive and debris
3. Making template of entire Teak Deck and cutting of Teakwood as per required size with joining of Teak as per templates 
4. Filling of Sikaflex 298 Black deck caulking in the grooves, after drying process, cutting of extra deck caulking from Teakwood grooves
5. Sanding of Teak deck surface to make it smooth & uniform
6. Sanding of deck (substrate) to get appropriate profile for bounding and cleaning of deck
7. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC black, 
8. After drying process, cleaning of extra adhesive from Teakwood grooves and cleaning of groove lines
9. Cleaning the groove by using router machine, hand sanding for groove cleaning 
10. Apply, primer & black caulking by using Sikaflex 290 DC, 
11. After curing extra recaulking cutting and sanding by using flat sander with P80 grid paper
12. Sanding the surface to make it smooth & uniform
13. Hand sanding where is not access by machine, in last washing & cleaning
14. Teak plank size 50mm wide 10mm thickness (After sanding and finishing) including groove (Groove width 5mm, depth 10mm)
15. Any material required other than quoted will be charged extra
16. In case of deck levelling required, will be additional charges.
Areas to be covered :- All existing exterior teak deck area; Approx 109m²

value.LineDescription:
Sanding and repaint of exterior hull and superstructure with Boero white paint
Scope of works:
1. . Protection covering and by using blue protection sheet & brown paper in required area
2. Sanding the entire exterior hull and superstructure area for paint application 
3. Dry guide coat application and long board block sanding 
4. Boero delta 3000 or defender primer. application on filler filling in required area 
5. Boero Epoyacht or Boero Epomar filer application 
6. Boero Delta UCHB primer application on filler filling surface. Again sanding & degreaser application 
7. Application of 2 to 3 coats of marine grade Boero Epoply primer 
8. Application of 2 to 3 coats of marine grade Boero white paint for full exterior area and wet sanding & buffing polishing work. 
9. According to the following and connected paint technique, apply a build-up thickness
For Primer (Wet film thickness 150-300 microns; Dry film thickness 3 – 4 mils; 75 – 150 microns) 
For White paint (Wet film thickness 90-130 microns; Dry film thickness 40 – 60 microns) 
10. Silicon work:- Removal of existing silicon, groove cleaning & filling new marine Bostick silicon 
11. Cleaning the groove and filling marine silicon after exterior final painting
Note: 
1. If any cracks are found on the surface after sanding, additional deep sanding or lamination work will be required and will incur extra charges, as this quotation has been prepared without a physical inspection.
2. Supply, erection, and dismantling of scaffolding, including shrink-wrap tenting for spray application with maintenance for three months
3. 10-ton x 5 AC unit supply & installation to control temperature during spray paint application for 3 months
4. Removal of existing silicon in V groove from full exterior, cleaning the groove by chemical and filling new marine silicon by using 3M Blue masking tape, fine line tape & other consumables
5. Total lead time for the painting works 90 to 100 Days
